description: ChordEdit image-editing testcase index derived from docs/test_cases_design_kevin.md.

source_validation.rule: Only source_validated=true images enter formal editing evaluation; null or false images remain draft or are regenerated.

image_storage.source_image_policy: One canonical source image per case; imported assets keep their actual resolution and generated assets record their generation resolution. The ChordEdit pipeline may resize inputs to its configured edit resolution.
image_storage.official_prompt_policy: official_web_example identifies prompt provenance only; it does not claim that the webpage screenshot is the benchmark source image.
image_storage.run_output_policy: Never overwrite outputs from another run_id; separate repeated seeds by filename.

score_semantics.3: partially successful with visible artifacts or semantic drift
score_semantics.5: target edit is accurate and the intended unchanged content is preserved

evaluation_schema.aggregation_note: Do not average boundary, text, style, and local-edit cases into one undifferentiated score.

cases.source_prompt: a dog looking at the camera
cases.edited_prompt: a dog wearing a red collar and looking at the camera
cases.edit_prompt: Add a red collar to the dog while preserving its pose, background, and lighting.
cases.intended_edit: Add a red dog collar.
cases.review_note: The official webpage screenshot is not the benchmark source; regenerate a canonical 512x512 source image from the official prompt.

cases.source_prompt: a white car driving
cases.edited_prompt: a stripe car driving
cases.edit_prompt: Reproduce the official example's stripe-car edit; semantically, interpret it as changing the car's body stripe while preserving the road, motion, perspective, and lighting.
cases.intended_edit: Official example wording: change the car's stripe appearance; the exact stripe color and geometry should be inspected from the source image.
cases.review_note: The official webpage screenshot is not the benchmark source; regenerate a canonical 512x512 source image from the official prompt.

cases.intended_edit: Change the shape of the latte-art drawing on the coffee surface; preserve the cup and scene.
cases.review_note: The official webpage screenshot is not the benchmark source; regenerate a canonical 512x512 source image from the official prompt.
